title: Implement V4 isolated Build Evidence Provider
goal: Build explicit projects in a run-owned isolated copy and bind fresh compiled evidence for Post consumers.
acceptanceCriteria: A separately registered provider declares TargetRoot reads, StateRoot/EvidenceRoot writes and dotnet process capability.
Builds run only in a link-free StateRoot copy with sanitized environment and no package source network.
The evidence manifest binds run, project, target snapshot, source project, configuration, framework, assembly identity and hash.
Architecture Conformance rejects stale, drifted, missing or escaping build evidence before ArchUnitNET inspection.
TargetRoot and PackageRoot remain unchanged and P0-P4D remain green.
Current V3 behavior remains unchanged with no active workflow or remote change.
